inputs.prompt: Connection test from SimGuard. Do not analyze anything and do not read any files. Reply only with the exact name of every input you accept, whether it is required or optional, and the allowed values for every fixed-choice input.

result.chatText:
I'll start by reading the app's skill and manifest files.**Connection test acknowledged — no project files read, no code analyzed.**

## Inputs accepted by "Research Code & Reproducibility Audit"

| # | Exact name | Required? | Type | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `project_path` | **Required** | string (free text) | Any absolute path in the workspace, or a short identifier when artifacts are uploaded instead. Example: `/home/user/workspaces/personal/navier-stokes-solver` |
| 2 | `artifacts` | Optional | files (upload) | Code, config YAML/JSON, logs, metrics CSVs, result files |
| 3 | `observed_symptom` | **Required** | textarea (free text) | Any description of the unexpected behaviour — NaN, divergence, plateau, stalled metric, wrong-looking plot, non-reproducing run |
| 4 | `focus_areas` | **Required** | multiselect | Fixed choices: `numerical` (Numerical stability), `reproducibility` (Reproducibility and seeding), `data_integrity` (Data integrity), `performance` (Performance and memory), `visualization` (Visualization and reporting), `all` (Everything) — **multiple allowed** |
| 5 | `analysis_depth` | **Required** | select | Fixed choices: `triage` (Triage — fastest pass, blocking issues only), `standard` (Standard — findings plus root-cause hypotheses), `deep` (Deep — full ledger plus experiment designs). Default: `standard` |
| 6 | `known_context` | Optional | textarea (free text) | Prior findings already ruled out, fixed, or documented |
| 7 | `expected_behavior` | Optional | textarea (free text) | Reference value, target metric, or convergence rate to compare against |

**Fixed-choice inputs** are exactly two: `focus_areas` (six values, multi-select) and `analysis_depth` (three values, single-select). All other fields are free text, and `artifacts` is a file upload.

**Summary of this run:** the request was a wiring/connection test, so per the instruction nothing was inspected and no audit was performed — zero confirmed issues, zero suspects, zero experiments, no files read. The seven inputs above are the complete accepted schema; a real run needs `project_path`, `observed_symptom`, `focus_areas`, and `analysis_depth` populated.
